notes: GWM's only currently orderable BEV in Australia is the Ora 5 SUV (Lux, Ultra). The original Ora hatch (Good Cat/Funky Cat) was discontinued around April/May 2026, superseded by the Ora 5; not included as it is no longer sellable as new stock. An Ora 5 Hatch and Ora 5 Touring (wagon, larger battery) have been referenced by AU press as coming 'later in 2026' but are unconfirmed/no specs - excluded pending confirmation. Haval Jolion Max BEV is a confirmed future AU launch targeting Q4 2026 but is not yet orderable and has no official specs published - excluded (announced only, insufficient verified data to list). GWM's ute range (Cannon, Cannon Alpha, Cannon Hi4-T) is diesel/PHEV only - no BEV ute exists in the AU lineup. No BEV van exists in the GWM/Ora/Haval AU range. GWM AU publishes drive-away pricing only; no official MSRP-before-on-roads figure exists (the pre-on-road figures below are back-calculated by CarExpert, medium confidence). Range cycle is WLTC per the brand site and AU press, not WLTP - recorded as null for rangeCycle since WLTC is not one of the permitted enum values, with the true value noted in fieldSources/notes per variant.
